findings.title: Mozilla dev-security-policy group message: Chrome Root Program received compromise report October 17, 2026
findings.summary_md: On Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 18:05 UTC the Chrome Root Program received a report from a security researcher that private keys associated with eight eMudhra intermediate certificates had been compromised. The message confirms the same eight intermediates later blocked by Go, Mozilla, and Chrome.

findings.title: Go release history: go1.27.3 released 2026-10-19 with crypto/x509 security fix
findings.summary_md: The official Go release history lists go1.27.3 as released on 2026-10-19, containing the security fix to crypto/x509 that filters out the eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates. Go 1.26.10 was released the same day with the same fix.
